_about: Section 2 of the launch page (If AI, which AI?), copied from content/page.json which_ai on 16 Nov 2026. Strings with src are paper text; ui lists every displayed string that is not. Pile counts and release dates come from rq2_writers.json (tools/build_rq2_data.py, from paper/figures/data/rq2_distill.json); model and lab names are its writer and lab fields.
title: If AI, which AI?

takeaway.t: Frontier models can name the lab behind an AI-generated text

steps.t: We create a dataset of short stories, news articles, and op-eds generated by 34 models from 11 labs.
Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5 and Argon can identify text from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google with 98% accuracy or more.
Moonshot's Kimi K3 is usually mistaken for Claude, and Alibaba's Qwen3.8 models for GPT.
Later reports name Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3, and date campaigns against Claude shortly before their release.

OpenAI.name: GPT
OpenAI.t: GPT hedges its claims, flags gaps instead of inventing specifics, and leans on aphorisms.

Anthropic.name: Claude
Anthropic.t: Claude treats opposing views charitably, writes with dry wit, and ends quietly.

Google.name: Gemini
Google.t: Gemini stacks adjectives and piles on intensifiers and stock clichés, and invents named sources and quotes in its news articles.
